items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think that that was like 1959, in that area. And soon after that, the next thing I believe that was actually Broadway was I think Bravo Giovanni. It was either Bravo Giovanni or Flower Drum Song.

ctx.x: Okay, let's see. Now let's go back. It would have had to have been after the first Ellington concert, the Carnegie thing. The Carnegie thing was in 1955, I think. So

that I would say that … Beggar's Holiday was the absolute first one. And I think that that was like 1959, in that area. And soon after that, the next thing I believe that was actually Broadway was I think Bravo Giovanni. It was either Bravo Giovanni or Flower Drum Song. That was like early '60s, I guess.
